parts.html:
Lesson information

Level: A0, children
Time: 60 minutes
Dialect: British

Vocabulary: colours, numbers 1–10, boy, girl, and basic feelings

Grammar: I’m a …, You’re a …, How old are you?, Are you OK?

Functional language: greetings, introductions, talking about age, expressing feelings, and responding to simple questions

Phonics: S /s/, A /æ/, T /t/

Goal: can recognise and use the key language from the unit

Speaking: can introduce themselves, say their age, respond to simple questions, and use basic social language in short exchanges

Functional language

Hello!
Goodbye!
What’s your name?
My name’s …
How old are you?
I’m six.
Are you OK?
I’m OK.
I’m not OK.
Thank you.

Vocabulary

red, green, blue, yellow
numbers 1–10
boy, girl, I, you

Grammar / language structures

I’m a boy / girl.
You’re a boy / girl.
I / you

Phonics

S /s/ — snake, sock
A /æ/ — apple, ant
T /t/ — top, tiger

items.label: Wave and say Hello! Invite the child to wave back. Play the familiar U
src: Hello song
Wave and say Hello! Invite the child to wave back. Play the familiar Unit 1 song and join in with the gestures.
Support: let them wave or clap if they do not want to sing.
Lead-in
Ask one short question, then wait for an answer.
What colour? → Blue. Boy or girl? → Boy. How old? → Six. /s/ — find S.
Support for less confident students:
offer two choices, for example Blue or red? Point to each option.
Fast finishers extension:
close the picture and let them tell you one clue from memory.
Ex 1.1 Who is behind the door? (pic)
Vocabulary
Model one request and drag the correct token into the mouth. Give the remaining requests in a different order.

items.label: Use the familiar Unit 1 routine. Demonstrate each movement before the
src: Stretch break
Use the familiar Unit 1 routine. Demonstrate each movement before the child joins in.
Support: let them do the movements sitting down. End with a calm signal and return to the pictures.
Grammar and Functional Language
Name the two characters and point to their age numbers before playing the clips. Play one clip at a time; let them point or draw a line to its card.
Support for less confident students:
offer two cards and replay. Do not require a written answer.
Fast finishers extension:
let them speak for A or B using the three model sentences.
Ex 1.1 Listen and point (pic + audio)
Script
Hello! My name’s Ann. I’m five. I’m a girl. Hello! My name’s Sam. I’m six. I’m a boy. Hello! My name’s Ann. I’m seven. I’m a girl. Hello! My name’s Sam. I’m eight. I’m a boy.
Suggested answers
